notes:
### Ostraca 0.7.18 for Windows

- **Transcripts** has a three-dot menu in the list and detail header. Name or rename a recording without renaming its files, open it in your player, or move the entry to the library trash after confirmation. Display names stay on this device.
- **Transcribe recording** works with saved audio up to 24 MiB using the OpenAI transcription model configured under **Services → AI & transcription**. The app asks before sending audio and saves text beside the original, without overwriting it.
- Libraries, sign-in and sync settings carry over. New Teams capture is unchanged; earlier Vexa recordings can still be recovered.
